source.note: Public weekly export; contributor names and sentence IDs retained in prepared data. Transcriptions without a username are not marked reviewed by Tatoeba.

teacher_expansion.reading_policy: Reject existing surface/POS with multiple readings, OOV and lexical boundary collisions; dictionary agreement is not contextual certification

data_curation.policy: TRAIN-only immutable-row filtering; punctuation/polite-style representatives, lexical/role-preserving pattern cap, explicit reviewed/topic quarantines; no quality certification

combination_holdout.initialization: random only; no prior task-trained checkpoint

split_audit.scope: NFKC + terminal period only; not semantic, paraphrase or combination disjointness

common_reference.scope: Union of actual task-training texts of all compared conditions; no validation/test membership

protocol: Independent request pools, seed = start + request_id*4 + candidate_index; shared prefixes for N=1/2/4. Scores are not naturalness or reading accuracy.
